items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Meyer Davis asked them to come into the Arcadia

ctx.x: Well, even a five or six piece band like that...playing together and playing different things and going from one key to the other, and really swinging, you know, this was unusual. And they went on and into strange things. However, as great as they were, and as great as they played together, they didn't come to New York City.

I was talking a little bit to Snub Mosley about that, and Snub said they did come to New York and, but just...I think they were playing theaters or something, and they were asked...
